messages:
Lina (AE): Quick: Polaris wants hosted POC. Must have per-stage keys (dev/stage/prod-sim), IP allowlist, 48h rotation, and an audit trail. They also asked for an HMAC-signed delivery webhook.
Omar (SE): We can create three scoped keys, each with model whitelist and CIDR. Rotation: generate new key material and push to signed webhook or expiring URL. TTL per key = 72h.
Theo (Sales Eng): Can we support rotating the same key id (key metadata stays) but swap secret so they don't have to update config entries?
Omar (SE): Yes, we can perform key material rotation in-place. Key id remains constant, secret changes. That plays nicer with infra. We'll note rotation timestamps in audit.
Lina (AE): Good. They also want proof that revoked keys cannot call endpoints.
support-bot: Test run: revoked_key_id=pk.poc.polaris_dev_230111; enforce revoke immediate. Simulation: POST /v1/generate returned 401 for revoked secret at 2301112235. Audit logged revoke event.
Theo (Sales Eng): Share minimal curl for their infra team. Make token placeholder and mention model param.
Omar (SE): Example: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_poc_POLARIS_DEV" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-4-compat","input":"ping"}'
Lina (AE): Delivery options? They want webhook + S3 pre-signed as fallback.
Omar (SE): We'll push to provided webhook (HMAC-SHA256 using provisioning secret) and also store a presigned S3 URL expiring in 3h. Both logged to audit.
Theo (Sales Eng): Who owns rotation failures & retries? Lina, SE oncall gets alerted and we have 3 retries at 5m intervals; if all fail we pause rotation and alert sales.
Lina (AE): Add that to SOW: "Rotation retries x3 then alert; existing secret remains until TTL."
Omar (SE): Done. Also recommend they pin model sha or version to avoid surprise behavior.
Lina (AE): Final ask: can we auto-revoke keys if user hasn't called API in 30d? They want security hygiene.
Omar (SE): We can add a stale-key lifecycle policy: optional flag to auto-revoke after N days of inactivity. For POCs we recommend 30d but default is off.
Lina (AE): Great. I'll update the SOW and gather webhook credentials. Thanks. :thumbsup:
